thread:
Maria: kicking off this month's recurring-incident themes review. quick ask: bring a 1-line summary of the top recurring causes you see and any blockers for fixes. agenda: 1) top 5 signatures, 2) remediation status, 3) ownership gaps, 4) short-term mitigations

Ajay: observed a spike in 'cold-start latency' signatures on dedicated pools — looks correlated with the larger nightly rollouts. root candidates: node churn + aggressive scale-to-zero. :eyes:

Luke: confirmed. autoscale config got stricter last quarter (`scaleDownGrace=30s`). that reduced cost but increased warmup failures under burst.

Tanya: note on remediation tracker: #234 (warm pool pre-warm) is still blocked by infra-side quota work. owner is @Ajay, ETA was EOW last week but blocked by cloud quota request.

Kevin: can we add a synthetic warmup test to CI that simulates burst traffic? cheap and would catch regressions early. happy to prototype.

Ajay: sounds good. I'm on the quota follow-up today with cloud team. Kevin — a simple load test that hits the pre-warm endpoint should be enough, a 60s ramp.

Maria: action item proposal (keeping it short):
```
- Action A: Add synthetic warmup test (owner: Kevin, ETA: 2026-04-02)
- Action B: Increase scaleDownGrace to 90s for dedicated pools (owner: Luke, ETA: 2026-04-09, rollback plan in config)
- Action C: Cloud quota escalation (owner: Ajay, ETA: 2026-04-01)
- Action D: Postmortem linkage: ensure all warmup-related incidents auto-link to #234 (owner: Tanya, ETA: 2026-04-03)
```

Tanya: tagging in the tracker now and adding acceptance criteria for #234. also flagging that we need SLO-adjusted alerts so noisy pre-warm spikes don't generate oncall churn.

incident-bot: summary for window 2026-03-01..2026-03-31: 28 incidents tagged as "warmup/cold-start", median time-to-detect 4.2m, top affected region: eu-west-1.

Luke: re: SLO-adjusted alerts — can we make a short rule: only page if >3x baseline for 5m AND overall error-rate >0.5%? that'll suppress single-instance flapping.

Kevin: prototype plan posted in PR 789. it includes the 60s ramp and a heuristic to emulate KV-cache coldness.

Ajay: update: quota escalation accepted with cloud; expected completion 2026-04-01. moving blocker->in-progress.

Maria: thanks. final asks before I close this thread: everyone please paste a 1-sentence progress update into the tracker by EOD tomorrow. I'll run a short retro next week to check whether the mitigation reduced incident recurrence. :white_check_mark:

Tanya: will do. adding a weekly digest to owners.

Luke: scheduling config change window for 2026-04-08, will include rollback knobs and runbook updates.

Kevin: prepping the synthetic test PR, aim to merge by 2026-04-02.

Ajay: will confirm quota completion and link cloud ticket.

Maria: done for now — thanks all :heart:
